purpose: Dewfield environment and opening reference sheets

prompts.village-reference: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: art direction reference sheet for original cozy farming game Dewfield. Produce a beautiful, consistent pixel art environment concept sheet, crisp clusters, limited warm ochre wood, cream plaster, moss and olive greens, dusty teal water, terracotta roofs, no smoothing or photographic effects. Orthographic 3/4 top-down view, readable at 16-pixel tile scale, classic GBA farming sim craftsmanship, matching a warm illustrated pixel countryside title screen. Five clearly separated compositions: a welcoming player farmhouse courtyard with a clear unobstructed path from front door, stone well off to the lower left with open walking space and a shipping crate much farther to the right beside the field; then four NPC homes, each exterior beside its roofless furnished interior: Xiaohe the young seed keeper (shop living quarters, plant nursery, potting shelf), Alan the carpenter (timber workshop home, tools and timber, bed and meal table), Cheng the lake fisher (waterfront cabin, nets, bait jars, rod rack, bed), Granny Lin the elder (sage green roof cottage, tea table, quilted bed, herb kitchen, flowers). Sensible door placements, shadow grounding, detailed tile seams and broken paving edges, clear circulation paths, distinct homes in one coherent visual family. Frame with small tasteful amber dividers, no watermarks, no logos, no textual UI. Wide sheet.
prompts.interior-mine-reference: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: pixel art interior furnishings and mine tile design reference for original farming game Dewfield. Beautiful production concept sheet in a coherent warm hand crafted GBA era top-down farming simulation style: crisp deliberately placed pixel clusters, 16px tile logic, warm amber timber, mossy green, dusty teal, cream highlights. Left half: a spacious cutaway cottage with bed, quilt, rug, kitchen hearth, shelves of earthenware, dining table and chairs, wall window and potted herbs; close up small furniture groups show contact shadows directly below feet, darker wall footing, furniture highlights. Right half: interconnected natural cave chambers with organic jagged rock walls, readable vertical cliff faces, scalloped edge transitions into gravel floor, cracked rock tiles of multiple variants, copper iron and violet crystal veins, mushrooms, wooden support beams, small warm lanterns, a clear upward elevator landing and descending ladder. Three geological palettes shallow brown/green, middle slate/blue, deep plum/amber. Walkable floor distinct from walls, do not scatter collision obstacles in all corridors. Layered wall faces with top rim and inward shadow at floor, varied stone silhouettes. No text, no watermark, no real game screenshots, no isometric diamond grid. Wide art direction sheet.
prompts.opening-reference: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: five-scene cinematic storyboard and background reference for original pixel farming game Dewfield. Create a polished coherent pixel art storyboard with FIVE large panels, arranged 3 panels above 2 panels, all landscape, no lettering or speech bubbles; the artwork should tell these specific beats: (1) rainy evening, close view of a warm lamp-lit handwritten childhood letter and envelope on a wooden desk next to an open window overlooking a quiet blue-grey city, tender introspection; (2) olive and cream rural bus crosses terraced fields towards sunlit misty green mountains at dawn, winding lane and little wildflowers; (3) at a cottage gate in the valley, small youthful traveler with blue overalls and chestnut hair receives a brass key from kindly grey-haired elderly woman, a welcoming path and terracotta roof, (4) seed shop keeper offers a packet of seeds beside the farmhouse while a fisher waves by the distant stream and bridge, (5) first farm sunrise, the same traveler and carpenter outside a small timber chicken coop, two chicks and a hay basket, cozy home visible beyond the garden. Classic refined GBA farming pixel art, clean cluster based shading, detailed natural silhouettes, golden amber wood and sunlight, olive sage greens, soft teal water, cream paper; moody night transitions naturally to hopeful dawn. Avoid thin stick people, maintain charming 2.5 head height characters, no blurry gradients, no smooth vector art, no watermark. Leave lower quarter of each panel visually quiet for later dialogue overlay; do not render UI. Wide sheet.
